repairs.description: Added package_id's restricted allowed-field mode, package_alias mutual exclusion, and the boundary that some fields are account-configuration or feature-flag dependent.
Added conditional subscription quantity requirements: quantity-only requires initial_quantity while seat-based requires seat_config and compatible grouping.
Added the documented immutability of scheduled_charges_on_usage_invoices after contract creation and clarified usage-statement custom-anchor and historical-import behavior.
Reframed the 4,561-line OpenAPI page as a request-family map with nested conditional rules instead of implying that the optional structures are a single flat or universally available contract model.
Recorded that uniqueness_key documents a 409 failure even though the operation response block lists only 200, 400, and 404, avoiding the claim that 409 is present in that response block.

contradictions.description: The uniqueness_key component says reuse fails with 409, but the operation response block lists only 200, 400, and 404; the canonical source preserves both facts.
Endpoint prose calls the prepaid trigger prepaid_balance_configuration, while CreateContractPayload names prepaid_balance_threshold_configuration; the canonical source follows the schema name.

review.notes: Reviewed the complete 4,561-line raw endpoint, Luna output, draft, and receipt, including the full schema inventory and request definitions. Luna correctly identified endpoint identity, required top-level fields, major optional families, term semantics, commits/credits, overrides, subscriptions, thresholds, hierarchy, lifecycle links, and uniqueness behavior. Sol added material package, availability, conditional, immutability, and response-boundary details and preserved two internal documentation mismatches without turning them into unsupported platform claims.
